end.summary:
Practised reading and plotting ordered pairs (x, y) on the coordinate plane.
Harsh identified x as sideways and y as upward, and identified Quadrant II for (−, +).
Harsh repeatedly treated (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point; this was not corrected by the end.
Discussed the origin (0, 0) as having both coordinates zero; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised moving sideways for the x-coordinate and upward for the y-coordinate, and correctly described (−, +) as Quadrant II. They continued to mix up the order of coordinates, so the difference between (3, 2) and (2, 3) was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to plot both points on one graph using two different colours and label each movement.
